[[File:Sith_Training_Gear_Darth_Maul.png|thumb|right|Sith training gear used by Darth Maul]]
[[Darth_Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] had worn uniquely tailored protective '''Sith training gear''' during his training. Once his skills had increased and he became a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], he would not require them anymore and instead be given traditional Sith black garb.
